capabilities: Export a folder of notes to PDF
Combine notes into one PDF with a linked table of contents
Add PDF bookmarks grouped by folder
Reorder and exclude notes before export
Keep internal links working inside the PDF
extras: Desktop only (Windows, macOS, Linux); not available on mobile. Runs fully locally with no network access. Embedded PDFs, audio, video and canvases export as placeholders, and links between separate PDFs work in desktop viewers (Acrobat, Foxit, SumatraPDF) but not most browsers. Mermaid export needs the vault's Mermaid permission. Some code block options (Shiki titles/line numbers, Advanced Codeblock line numbers) are not printed, matching Obsidian's own PDF export.
problem: Obsidian's built-in PDF export only handles one note at a time, so exporting a whole folder means repeating the process note by note.

relations.evidence: Keeps the styling of plugin content, including Code Styler code blocks
Slow plugin content such as Dataview may need more time

summary: Batch exporter that turns a folder of Obsidian notes into PDF, either one file per note or a single combined PDF with table of contents and bookmarks.
